item.title: Google acquires Wyoming data center site from AI infrastructure firm Crusoe
item.description: Google has acquired Crusoe's data center site in southeast Wyoming, the AI infrastructure developer said on Friday, a day after the Alphabet unit announced a $17-billion investment in the project.

item.title: ETtech Deals Digest: Eloelo leads as weekly funding rises to $142 million, down 35% on-year
item.description: Eloelo led deal activity with $80 million, followed by Peppermint Robotics at $10.6 million, altM at $10.3 million, Two Point O Capital at $10 million, and PowerUp Money at $10 million. Crane Venture Partners was among the most active investors, backing Peppermint Robotics and Armatrix. Omnivore invested in altM and Two Point O Capital, while Flourish Ventures backed PowerUp Money.

item.title: District's PVR INOX ticket sales jump 60%, rivals lag at 4%
item.description: According to data shared by District CEO Rahul Ganjoo on LinkedIn on Thursday, tickets booked through District for PVR INOX cinemas grew 60% in the April-September 2026 period compared with the same period last year. In contrast, ticket sales through all other online channels grew an estimated 4%.

item.title: Honasa Consumer revenue grows 36% in Q2, highest since listing
item.description: The company’s net profit rose 87% to Rs 73 crore in the second quarter of FY27, compared with Rs 39 crore in the year-ago period. Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortisation (Ebitda) nearly doubled to Rs 93 crore from Rs 48 crore a year earlier, while the Ebitda margin expanded to 12.7% from 8.9%.

item.title: Angel One overtakes Zerodha to become India's second-largest stockbroker
item.description: Angel One's active client base rose to 69.98 lakh at the end of October, from 67.56 lakh in September. In comparison, Zerodha's active clients declined to 67.59 lakh from 67.92 lakh a month ago.

item.title: Scripbox shareholders approve conversion into public company ahead of IPO
item.description: At an extraordinary general meeting on October 19, shareholders approved the change of the Accel-backed startup's name from Scripbox Wealth Managers Private Limited to Scripbox Wealth Managers Limited, along with amendments to its constitutional documents, according to regulatory filings reviewed by ET.

item.title: Festive stocking drives 36% jump in TReDS volumes as small businesses seek working capital
item.description: The five platforms operating under the Trade Receivables Discounting System (TReDS) financed invoices worth Rs 75,788 crore in August and September, a 36% increase from Rs 55,549 crore in the same months last year, according to RBI data.

item.title: Ex-Ultrahuman executive launches AI ring startup Aina for agentic interactions
item.description: The startup said it is positioning the device as an alternative interface to smartphones for everyday interactions with AI systems. It has spent the past 15 months developing the product and is now opening pre-orders globally, with prices starting at $399 (about Rs 36,000), the startup said in a statement.

item.title: Go Digit posts 31% dip in net profit to Rs 142 crore
item.description: The company’s management had previously noted that in the last five years there has been no increase in third-party motor insurance rates, while pricing across most lines has drifted down and claims costs have continued to rise.

item.title: Cosmoserve Space raises $6 million, sets up India's first space debris removal facility in Hyderabad
item.description: The facility comprises an orbital rendezvous and capture lab, a space robotics innovation lab, an ISO Class 8 satellite integration clean room and a mission simulation and control centre. It will enable the company to design, build and test robotic capture systems and develop capabilities for satellite servicing, including in-orbit repairs and refuelling.
